title: Mutual perpetual check is a draw

boundary.expect: second occurrence; not yet a mutual draw

rationale: The same six-piece skeleton as mx-chk-003 and mx-chk-004 carrying both cannons at once: Red's cannon on g5 checks the black king after every red move and Black's cannon on d7 checks the red king after every black move, so the side to move stands in check at all nine plies of the wheel and each side's move is simultaneously a check evasion and a check. Pins that when both sides commit the same violation class the result is the reserved mutual draw rather than a loss for either side, and that a mutual perpetual check is constructible on the 7-by-7 board.
